svg.title: Plan Mode or Direct Execution
svg.desc: Task size decides the mode: a single-file fix with a clear cause goes straight to direct execution, while a migration or restructuring goes to plan mode with Explore for discovery, then direct execution to implement the agreed plan.
svg.text: Plan when the change is big or has several valid designs; act when it's small and clear.
LARGE OR ARCHITECTURAL: MIGRATION, 40 DEPENDENT FILES
SMALL AND CLEAR: ONE-FILE FIX, KNOWN CAUSE
